subject.title: fix(memory): keep implicit embeddings recall available

question: Should implicit or legacy-auto OpenAI embeddings preserve compatible read-only lexical recall when direct OpenAI API-key authentication becomes unavailable, rather than surfacing memory search as unavailable?
rationale: The branch has evidence for the behavior and matches documentation, but it deliberately changes the observable upgrade-time failure mode for existing implicit-provider users.

options.title: Accept documented lexical fallback
options.body: Merge the scoped fallback for implicit and legacy-auto providers while keeping explicit remote providers fail-closed.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject the runtime fallback and revise the documentation so implicit OpenAI embeddings require API-key authentication for memory search.

options.title: Narrow the recovery lifecycle first
options.body: Keep the fallback direction but request a smaller follow-up that separates retry and recovery orchestration before accepting the behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept documented lexical fallback
recommendation.body: Merge the scoped fallback for implicit and legacy-auto providers while keeping explicit remote providers fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author assembled the concrete runtime and source evidence needed to answer the behavior question; final product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
